hero.title: Growing through integrity and disciplined execution.
hero.p1: Ocean Space is a corporate group overseeing four active business units — distribution, retail, sub-retail, and lifestyle. We stand on one defining principle: sustainable growth can only be built upon consistent operating standards and a culture of honesty.
hero.p2: From national distribution corridors to retail stores and community branches, every unit operates under one unified cultural language — the JUJUR framework (Jujur, Unggul, Jaga Pelanggan, Ulet, Rasa Memiliki). These five principles form the foundation of how we hire, execute, and grow.

principles.heading: Five principles that guide every decision.
principles.subtitle: The JUJUR framework translates our core cultural values into concrete daily behaviors across every business unit.

items.label: JUJUR · Principle 01
items.title: J — Honesty & Integrity
items.description: Decisions rooted in transparency and true accountability.
items.detail: All operations are backed by verified data. Integrity ensures every working promise aligns with real field execution.

items.label: UNGGUL · Principle 02
items.title: U — Performance Excellence
items.description: Disciplined execution and continuous drive for quality.
items.detail: We measure achievements using clear operational indicators, empowering each business unit to exceed foundational benchmarks.

items.label: JAGA · Principle 03
items.title: J — Customer Care & Focus
items.description: Long-term relationships built with full respect.
items.detail: Customers and business partners are at the heart of our group's growth. Consistent service safeguards high trust across all operational regions.

items.label: ULET · Principle 04
items.title: U — Resilience & Growth
items.description: Proactive learning and taking on greater responsibilities.
items.detail: Field challenges are tackled proactively. Employees and units are given space to grow in tandem with expanding organizational capacity.

items.label: RASA MEMILIKI · Principle 05
items.title: R — Sense of Ownership
items.description: Full accountability for group efficiency and results.
items.detail: Protecting assets, quality of work, and group reputation with personal ownership, driving synergy across all business units.
